description: Use for internal linking from the latest crawl snapshot. Set view: page (one page's inlinks/outlinks; pass url), anchor (which pages use an anchor and where it points; pass anchor, optional limit), opportunities (source pages that should link to a target; pass url, optional limit). No snapshot returns status=ok with na and nextActions (run_audit), not an error. For the full page picture prefer get_evidence.

anchor.description: Anchor text to search for (case-insensitive substring; exact matches rank first). Omit to list the most used anchors.

url.description: Page URL or path on the site's domain

view.description: Which read to run; see the tool description for each view.

name: get_links
title: Read internal links from the latest crawl
